 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Ranjeet Ranjan  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Yogendra Kumar

==
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 3 10-07-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State.
Nobody appears on behalf of the Central Bureau of Investigation.

2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Special Case No. 07 of 2016 (now the present case number is special case No. 09 of 2024) registered for the offence punishable under Sections 420/120(B) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 13(1)(d) read with Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act.
3. As per the prosecution case, the petitioner is not named in the F.I.R., his name surfaced during the course of investigation.

From the chargesheet, it appears that the petitioner being the Assistant Manager (Finance) NBCC, Patna Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.19694 of 2025(3) dt.10-07-2025 Zone, had prepared and signed the requisitions for payment dated 18.03.2015 for an amount of Rs.
1,43,76,150/ for Muzaffarpur and Rs. 93,42,324/- for Bodh Gaya and were sent to Fund Section,
H.O. NBCC, New Delhi for payment to M/s GVS Design Matrix Pvt. Ltd.

Earlier he had checked and passed two false and fictitious abstracts of payment dated 18.03.2015 for payment of an amount of Rs. 1,79,47,825/ for Muzaffarpur Works and Rs.1,16,63,372/-for Bodh Gaya Works under JNNURM/UIDSSMT respectively to M/s. GVS Design Matrix Pvt. Ltd. and were withdrawn by the Govt. of Bihar from NBCC in 2009.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case.
He further submits that the role of the petitioner is only limited to the extent that he has to provide assistance for calculation of bills i.e. arithmetically checked.
5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of the State has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail.
6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that the petitioner hatching conspiracy with co- accused persons has embezzled huge money by way of cheating Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.19694 of 2025(3) dt.10-07-2025 causing heavy loss to the State exchequer, this application is dismissed.

(Prabhat Kumar Singh, J) Saif/-
